verdict.rationale: Medusa maintains full OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin REST APIs, and these power the docs.medusajs.com/api reference. That confirms a machine-readable, generated API reference exists, but nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. The probe's 404s only show the spec isn't served at common docs paths; they don't contradict the reference itself. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request functionality, code samples per endpoint, first-party docs describing the reference experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.
